task.title: Add CSV import to Renzo contacts
task.description: Add CSV import to the existing Renzo contacts page. Keep ALL existing functionality. ADD ONLY: a file input button labeled 'Import CSV' on the contacts page. When a CSV is selected: parse it, auto-detect columns (look for name/first/last, company/organization, email, phone in headers case-insensitively), show a preview modal with the first 5 rows and detected column mapping, confirm button imports all rows as contacts with localStorage, skip rows where name AND company are both empty, show result: 'Imported X contacts, skipped Y duplicates'. Use vanilla JS FileReader API, no external libraries.
task.project_vision: Renzo is a frontend-only AI outreach tool. Single HTML file. localStorage. No backend. Add CSV import so users can bulk-load contacts.
